segments.text: К 2030 году установить 20 систем раннего предупреждения о наводнениях при условии международного финансирования. Ведущее ведомство — Министерство водных ресурсов.
segments.english_text: Install 20 flood early-warning systems by 2030, conditional on international financing. The Water Ministry will lead delivery.

segments.text: Modernize 30 hectares of irrigation by 2030; extend to 50 hectares by 2035 if external finance is secured. The Agriculture Agency is the lead.
segments.english_text: Modernize 30 hectares of irrigation by 2030; extend to 50 hectares by 2035 if external finance is secured. The Agriculture Agency is the lead.

segments.text: Heat protection for older people is an explicit priority; no action or numeric target is specified.
segments.english_text: Heat protection for older people is an explicit priority; no action or numeric target is specified.

segments.text: Flood-prone settlements face disrupted road access. Older people have limited evacuation access; local shelters provide emergency capacity.
segments.english_text: Flood-prone settlements face disrupted road access. Older people have limited evacuation access; local shelters provide emergency capacity.

segments.text: Prepare community cooling plans with participation by older people and persons with disabilities. No deadline or lead institution is stated.
segments.english_text: Prepare community cooling plans with participation by older people and persons with disabilities. No deadline or lead institution is stated.

segments.text: Reduce emissions by 25 percent against a business-as-usual scenario by 2030.
segments.english_text: Reduce emissions by 25 percent against a business-as-usual scenario by 2030.

segments.text: Improve wastewater and sanitation systems. Partners are a financing source; no delivery condition is stated.
segments.english_text: Improve wastewater and sanitation systems. Partners are a financing source; no delivery condition is stated.

segments.text: Establish community repair circles to maintain emergency equipment. The local term repair circles has no agreed topic mapping in this example.
segments.english_text: Establish community repair circles to maintain emergency equipment. The local term repair circles has no agreed topic mapping in this example.

segments.text: Coordinate health, water, electricity and transport services for heat emergencies. Agencies will share risk information, prepare backup arrangements and consult affected communities. Financing responsibilities remain ambiguous; the schedule is in an unprocessed annex, and a scanned finance table is unreadable.
segments.english_text: Coordinate health, water, electricity and transport services for heat emergencies. Agencies will share risk information, prepare backup arrangements and consult affected communities. Financing responsibilities remain ambiguous; the schedule is in an unprocessed annex, and a scanned finance table is unreadable.

segments.text: The invented update reports that five warning systems operated in 2024. This statement does not assess progress against the 2030 target.
segments.english_text: The invented update reports that five warning systems operated in 2024. This statement does not assess progress against the 2030 target.

segments.text: Reduce emissions by 40 percent against the 1990 historical baseline by 2030, subject to international support.
segments.english_text: Reduce emissions by 40 percent against the 1990 historical baseline by 2030, subject to international support.

segments.text: The later invented edition states 20 flood warning systems by 2032; continuity with the earlier 2030 statement is unresolved.

topics.name: Climate planning and governance
topics.definition: Strategies, plans, laws, institutional coordination and mainstreaming.
topics.routing_rule: A finance mechanism also needs CLM-02; do not tag all climate text here.

topics.name: Climate finance and support
topics.definition: Funding mechanisms, investment planning, budget integration, insurance and international support.
topics.routing_rule: A funding source alone does not establish conditionality.

topics.name: Climate information and risk assessment
topics.definition: Observations, scenarios, vulnerability assessments, risk maps and climate services.
topics.routing_rule: Use CLM-04 for operational warnings and preparedness.

topics.name: Early warning and disaster preparedness
topics.definition: Warnings, emergency planning, evacuation, civil protection and disaster readiness.
topics.routing_rule: Do not infer operational warning capacity from a risk study.

topics.name: Climate monitoring and reporting
topics.definition: GHG inventories, transparency, adaptation indicators, evaluation and reporting.
topics.routing_rule: An expected monitoring indicator is not evidence of a result.

topics.name: Economy-wide emissions targets
topics.definition: National emissions ceilings, reduction pledges, net-zero and economy-wide intensity targets.
topics.routing_rule: Sectoral targets use the relevant sector topic; keep EU-wide scope explicit.

topics.name: Land carbon and removals
topics.definition: Sequestration, land-use emissions/removals, forest carbon and LULUCF accounting.
topics.routing_rule: Carbon-sink wording alone does not establish biodiversity benefits.

topics.name: Renewable electricity
topics.definition: Solar, wind, hydropower and other renewable electricity, including distributed generation.
topics.routing_rule: Rooftop PV alone does not imply an Urban label.

topics.name: Grids and energy storage
topics.definition: Transmission, distribution, interconnection, flexibility, storage and network resilience.
topics.routing_rule: A generating plant without grid measures belongs to ENE-01 or ENE-05.

topics.name: Clean heating and fuels
topics.definition: District heating, heat pumps, renewable heat and lower-emission fuel switching.
topics.routing_rule: Vehicle fuel measures use TRN-01; building retrofit packages may also use URB-01.

topics.name: Energy efficiency and demand management
topics.definition: Energy audits, performance standards, efficient equipment and demand management.
topics.routing_rule: Prefer a more specific building, industrial or transport topic when applicable.

topics.name: Fossil energy transition
topics.definition: Coal/oil/gas transition, fossil asset retirement, subsidy reform and supply changes.
topics.routing_rule: Do not infer transition success from a plan or fuel switch.

topics.name: Oil and gas methane
topics.definition: Fugitive emissions, leaks, venting and flaring across oil/gas supply.
topics.routing_rule: Landfill methane uses WST-02; agricultural methane uses AGR-03.

topics.name: Irrigation efficiency
topics.definition: Agricultural water delivery, irrigation modernization and water-saving technologies.
topics.routing_rule: Municipal water supply uses WAT-01; solar irrigation may also use ENE-01.

topics.name: Resilient crops and soils
topics.definition: Crop varieties, soil health, erosion control, land management and resilient farming.
topics.routing_rule: Forest management uses BIO-01; record explicit carbon accounting under CLM-07.

topics.name: Livestock and manure
topics.definition: Animal health/resilience, feed, manure and agricultural methane/nitrous oxide measures.
topics.routing_rule: Human health uses HEA topics.

topics.name: Food systems and farm livelihoods
topics.definition: Food security, agricultural advice, storage, value chains and farm livelihoods.
topics.routing_rule: Food-waste disposal can also use WST-01 when a distinct measure is stated.

topics.name: Water supply and groundwater
topics.definition: Water availability, abstraction, groundwater, drinking water, storage and network losses.
topics.routing_rule: Farm irrigation uses AGR-01; sanitation uses WST-03.

topics.name: River basins and drought management
topics.definition: Basin management, allocation, drought planning, environmental flows and shared waters.
topics.routing_rule: Flood defenses use WAT-03; warnings may also use CLM-04.

topics.name: Flood and coastal protection
topics.definition: River/coastal flood risk, defenses, erosion and sea-level adaptation.
topics.routing_rule: General settlement planning may additionally use URB-02.

topics.name: Water quality and reuse
topics.definition: Surface-water quality, pollution prevention, safe reuse and receiving-water protection.
topics.routing_rule: Wastewater treatment systems use WST-03; keep both if both purposes are explicit.

topics.name: Forest health and management
topics.definition: Forest condition, sustainable management, wildfire/pest control and forest resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Carbon-only forest targets use CLM-07 without an inferred biodiversity claim.

topics.name: Species, habitats and protected areas
topics.definition: Species conservation, habitats, connectivity and terrestrial/aquatic protected areas.
topics.routing_rule: Active ecosystem restoration uses BIO-03.

topics.name: Ecosystem restoration
topics.definition: Restoration of forests, wetlands, peatlands and ecosystems, including ecosystem adaptation.
topics.routing_rule: Record carbon or adaptation co-benefits only with evidence.

topics.name: Heat and human health
topics.definition: Heat-health plans, cooling access, exposure and vulnerable-group protection.
topics.routing_rule: Urban greening uses URB-03 when the physical intervention is stated.

topics.name: Climate-sensitive disease and exposure
topics.definition: Infectious disease, water/vector-borne illness, air-quality exposure and surveillance.
topics.routing_rule: Do not assume health outcomes from emissions reductions alone.

topics.name: Resilient health services
topics.definition: Health facilities, service delivery, emergency capacity, staffing and essential supplies.
topics.routing_rule: General civil protection uses CLM-04.

topics.name: Building energy performance
topics.definition: Building insulation, retrofits, performance codes, passive design and energy-saving systems.
topics.routing_rule: Urban is a taxonomy domain here, not proof of urban geographic scope.

topics.name: Resilient settlements and infrastructure
topics.definition: Spatial planning, building safety, urban drainage and local infrastructure resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Sector-specific transport or energy networks use their specific topics.

topics.name: Urban cooling and green spaces
topics.definition: Trees, green/blue spaces, shading and cooling-oriented public-space design.
topics.routing_rule: General forest restoration uses BIO-03; health links require explicit evidence.

topics.name: Materials, recycling and circularity
topics.definition: Prevention, separate collection, recycling, composting, food waste and circular material use.
topics.routing_rule: Landfill gas uses WST-02; industrial production measures may use IND-01.

topics.name: Solid-waste disposal and methane
topics.definition: Landfill management/emissions, gas capture and disposal-facility resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Oil/gas methane uses ENE-06.

topics.name: Wastewater and sanitation
topics.definition: Sewage, wastewater treatment, sanitation, sludge and associated emissions/resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Receiving-water quality/reuse measures may also use WAT-04.

topics.name: Low-emission vehicles and fuels
topics.definition: Electrification, charging, cleaner transport fuels and vehicle standards.
topics.routing_rule: Public transport service improvements use TRN-02 where relevant.

topics.name: Public, active and shared mobility
topics.definition: Public transport, rail shift, walking, cycling and reduced private-car dependence.
topics.routing_rule: Transport hazard resilience uses TRN-03.

topics.name: Resilient transport networks
topics.definition: Protection/adaptation of roads, railways, ports, airports and logistics.
topics.routing_rule: Emissions measures use TRN-01 or TRN-02.

topics.name: Cleaner production and industrial efficiency
topics.definition: Industrial energy/material efficiency, production technology, modernization and factory resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Process gases/refrigerants use IND-02.

topics.name: Process emissions and refrigerants
topics.definition: Industrial process emissions, cement/chemicals, fluorinated gases and refrigerants.
topics.routing_rule: Generic factory energy efficiency uses IND-01.

topics.name: Tourism adaptation and destination resilience
topics.definition: Destination risks, changing seasons, diversification and resilient visitor infrastructure.
topics.routing_rule: Only use Tourism when the sector is explicit.

topics.name: Tourism resource efficiency
topics.definition: Tourism-specific water, energy, waste and sustainable visitor/accommodation measures.
topics.routing_rule: Keep sector topics too where the source explicitly describes the intervention.

dimensions.label: Objectives
dimensions.question: What policy purpose is evidenced?
dimensions.rule: Choose only source-supported purposes; a NAP location alone does not establish adaptation. Mitigation here means emissions reduction or carbon sinks. Disaster-impact mitigation (such as flood mitigation) belongs to disaster risk reduction when supported; a word match alone is insufficient.

options.label: Adaptation
options.definition: Adjustment to actual or expected climate effects and their consequences.

options.label: Climate mitigation
options.definition: Reduction of greenhouse-gas emissions or enhancement of carbon sinks.

options.label: Disaster risk reduction
options.definition: Prevention of new disaster risk, reduction of existing risk, or management of residual risk.

options.label: Unspecified
options.definition: The purpose is relevant but cannot be determined from this evidence.

dimensions.label: Record kinds
dimensions.question: What kind of information is this?
dimensions.rule: Separate promises from observations. Attach targets and other typed details to the appropriate record.

options.label: Commitment
options.definition: An attributable promise to undertake an action or achieve an outcome.

options.label: Priority
options.definition: An area or goal explicitly identified as important, without necessarily making an actionable promise.

options.label: Context
options.definition: Background conditions, risks, assessments or explanatory information.

options.label: Implementation observation
options.definition: A dated and attributed report that an action has begun or been carried out; not independent verification.

options.label: Result observation
options.definition: A dated and attributed report of an outcome or measured result; not independent verification.

dimensions.label: Assertion kinds
dimensions.question: How is the statement presented?
dimensions.rule: Preserve source modality; a scenario or recommendation must not become a government commitment.

options.label: Planned
options.definition: Intended future action or outcome.

options.label: Observed
options.definition: The source describes something as measured, experienced or carried out.

options.label: Projected
options.definition: An estimated future outcome derived from assumptions or modelling.

options.label: Scenario
options.definition: A hypothetical pathway or conditional future, not a prediction or promise.

options.label: Recommendation
options.definition: Advice about what should be done, without evidence of adoption.

options.label: Historical
options.definition: A statement about a past period.

options.label: Template
options.definition: Example wording or a form to complete, rather than a country assertion.

options.label: Unclear
options.definition: The statement type cannot be resolved confidently from the evidence.

dimensions.label: Documentation statuses
dimensions.question: How concrete is the document statement?
dimensions.rule: This is a documentary classification, not a scale of implementation performance.

options.label: Mentioned
options.definition: The subject is named without a specific priority or action.

options.label: Priority stated
options.definition: The document explicitly identifies the subject as a priority.

options.label: Action proposed
options.definition: An action is suggested or proposed without a clear commitment.

options.label: Action committed
options.definition: An attributable action or target is committed.

options.label: Implementation reported
options.definition: The source reports implementation activity; preserve the date and attribution.

options.label: Result reported
options.definition: The source reports results; preserve method, date and attribution.

options.label: Unclear
options.definition: The level of documentary commitment cannot be resolved.

dimensions.label: Temporal roles
dimensions.question: How does an edition relate to the selected period?
dimensions.rule: Do not infer supersession from a later filename or upload timestamp.

options.label: Current
options.definition: The variant applies to the selected current reporting scope.

options.label: Historical
options.definition: Retained to describe an earlier period.

options.label: Superseded
options.definition: Evidence explicitly establishes replacement by another variant.

options.label: Parallel
options.definition: Coexisting variants, such as conditional scenarios, without established replacement.

options.label: Unresolved
options.definition: The temporal relationship remains uncertain.

dimensions.label: Conditionalities
dimensions.question: Does delivery depend on a stated condition?
dimensions.rule: A financing mention alone does not prove conditionality. Keep conditions next to headline numbers.

options.label: Explicitly conditional
options.definition: The source explicitly makes the action or target dependent on support or another condition.

options.label: Explicitly unconditional
options.definition: The source explicitly describes the action or target as unconditional.

options.label: Not stated
options.definition: The selected source states no condition; do not relabel this as unconditional.

options.label: Unclear
options.definition: Conditional wording exists but its scope or meaning is uncertain.

dimensions.label: Hazards
dimensions.question: Which potentially damaging process is discussed?
dimensions.rule: Apply only to supported content. A hazard is not exposure or vulnerability. This compact list is not the complete UNDRR hazard classification.

options.label: Flood
options.definition: Water inundating land that is normally dry.

options.label: Drought
options.definition: A sustained precipitation or water deficit affecting systems or people.

options.label: Extreme heat
options.definition: Unusually high temperatures or heat episodes.

options.label: Wildfire
options.definition: Uncontrolled vegetation fire.

options.label: Storm
options.definition: Damaging wind or storm conditions; preserve the specific storm type in the source text.

options.label: Sea level rise
options.definition: Rising average sea level affecting coastal systems.

options.label: Coastal erosion
options.definition: Loss or retreat of coastal land through erosion.

options.label: Landslide
options.definition: Downslope movement of soil, rock or debris.

options.label: Avalanche
options.definition: Rapid downslope movement of snow or ice.

options.label: Glacial lake outburst
options.definition: Sudden release of water from a glacial lake.

options.label: Water scarcity
options.definition: Insufficient usable water relative to demand; distinguish drivers from drought when stated.

options.label: Extreme cold
options.definition: Unusually low temperatures or cold episodes.

options.label: Disease
options.definition: A disease-related threat; preserve pathogen, vector and climate linkage where stated.

options.label: Earthquake
options.definition: Ground shaking or associated seismic threat; not automatically climate-related.

options.label: Tsunami
options.definition: Large sea waves generated by displacement; not automatically climate-related.

options.label: Technological accident
options.definition: Accidental technological or industrial threat.

options.label: Compound hazard
options.definition: Interacting or concurrent hazards explicitly discussed together.

options.label: Other
options.definition: A supported hazard outside this compact list; retain the exact source term in unmapped_terms.

dimensions.label: Risk components
dimensions.question: Which part of the risk pathway is described?
dimensions.rule: Use components independently. A hazard mention does not establish exposed people, susceptibility or a quantified risk.

options.label: Hazard
options.definition: A potentially damaging event, process or activity.

options.label: Exposure
options.definition: People, livelihoods, assets or systems located where hazards may occur.

options.label: Vulnerability
options.definition: Conditions that make exposed people or systems more susceptible to harm.

options.label: Capacity
options.definition: Resources, skills, institutions or capabilities to manage risk.

options.label: Impact
options.definition: A consequence or loss resulting from an event or pressure.

options.label: Risk assessment
options.definition: An assessment connecting hazard, exposure, vulnerability or capacity.

options.label: Residual risk
options.definition: Risk remaining after measures have been applied or planned.

options.label: Systemic cascading risk
options.definition: Risk that spreads through linked systems or creates successive effects.

dimensions.label: Drr phases
dimensions.question: Which disaster-risk function does this support?
dimensions.rule: Phases can overlap but each selected phase needs evidence. Preparedness and response are different functions.

options.label: Risk understanding
options.definition: Understand or assess hazards, exposure, vulnerability and risk.

options.label: Prevention
options.definition: Avoid the creation of new disaster risk.

options.label: Risk reduction
options.definition: Reduce existing disaster risk.

options.label: Preparedness
options.definition: Build readiness to act effectively before or when a disaster occurs.

options.label: Anticipatory action
options.definition: Act ahead of a predicted event based on a forecast, trigger or warning.

options.label: Response
options.definition: Immediate action during or directly after an event to protect people and meet urgent needs.

options.label: Recovery
options.definition: Restore and improve affected systems and livelihoods after disaster.

options.label: Cross phase
options.definition: The statement explicitly spans several disaster-risk phases.

options.label: Unspecified
options.definition: DRR is relevant but the phase is not specified.

dimensions.label: Resilience functions
dimensions.question: Which resilience capacity is supported?
dimensions.rule: These are project analytical facets, not an official exhaustive resilience taxonomy.

options.label: Anticipate
options.definition: Foresee and prepare for a possible disturbance.

options.label: Absorb
options.definition: Withstand a shock while retaining essential functions.

options.label: Adapt
options.definition: Adjust practices or systems as conditions change.

options.label: Transform
options.definition: Make fundamental changes to underlying systems or development pathways.

options.label: Recover
options.definition: Restore functions and livelihoods after disruption.

options.label: Unspecified
options.definition: Resilience is relevant but the function is not specified.

dimensions.label: Missing reasons

options.label: Unreadable

dimensions.label: Section states

dimensions.label: Geography scopes

options.label: Unknown

dimensions.label: Target kinds
dimensions.question: What form does the target take?
dimensions.rule: Qualitative commitments are valid records. Do not invent a numeric measure.

options.label: Quantitative
options.definition: An explicitly measurable quantity, percentage or numeric threshold.

options.label: Deliverable
options.definition: A specified output such as adoption of a plan or establishment of a system.

options.label: Qualitative
options.definition: A non-numeric direction or intended improvement.

dimensions.label: Target comparators
dimensions.question: How should the numeric value be read?
dimensions.rule: Preserve mathematical meaning; do not convert a minimum into an exact target.

options.label: Equal
options.definition: An exact stated value.

options.label: At least
options.definition: A lower bound or minimum.

options.label: At most
options.definition: An upper bound or maximum.

options.label: Range
options.definition: A stated lower-to-upper interval.

options.label: Approximate
options.definition: An explicitly approximate value.

options.label: Not stated
options.definition: No comparison operator is stated.

dimensions.label: Target directions
dimensions.question: Which direction is intended?
dimensions.rule: Direction is not implementation progress and does not imply desirability without context.

options.label: Increase

options.label: Decrease

options.label: Maintain

options.label: Complete

options.label: Unspecified
options.definition: No direction is specified.

dimensions.label: Target bases

dimensions.label: Target totals
dimensions.question: Does the number mean total or additional?
dimensions.rule: Do not add a total to existing capacity or mistake an increment for the final total.

options.label: Total
options.definition: The final total intended at the target date.

options.label: Additional
options.definition: An increment beyond a stated or unstated existing level.

options.label: Not stated
options.definition: The source does not clarify total versus increment.

dimensions.label: Actor roles
dimensions.question: What responsibility does the institution have?
dimensions.rule: Retain original/English names. A ministry mention does not establish leadership.

options.label: Lead
options.definition: The source assigns lead responsibility.

options.label: Supporting
options.definition: The source assigns a supporting role.

options.label: Financier
options.definition: The actor provides or is expected to provide finance.

options.label: Reporting
options.definition: The actor reports or monitors implementation/results.

options.label: Beneficiary
options.definition: The actor or group is identified as a beneficiary.

options.label: Other
options.definition: Another explicitly stated role.

options.label: Unspecified
options.definition: The actor is mentioned but its role is unspecified.

dimensions.label: Finance kinds
dimensions.question: What does the financing amount or statement represent?
dimensions.rule: Do not merge costs, requests and secured funds or calculate a gap without compatible operands.

options.label: Estimated cost
options.definition: An estimated cost of an action or programme.

options.label: Approved budget
options.definition: A budget described as approved.

options.label: Secured
options.definition: Finance described by the source as secured; preserve date and attribution.

options.label: Requested
options.definition: Finance requested or sought.

options.label: Stated gap
options.definition: A financing gap explicitly stated in the source.

options.label: Financing source
options.definition: A named financing source or mechanism without necessarily specifying an amount.

dimensions.label: Detail kinds
dimensions.question: What supporting information is linked to the record?
dimensions.rule: Linked detail is distinct from the target. Keep its own evidence and relationship.

options.label: Support need
options.definition: A stated need for finance, capacity, technology or other support.

options.label: Barrier
options.definition: A stated obstacle to implementation.

options.label: Implementation step
options.definition: A stated step or sequence for implementation.

options.label: Coordination
options.definition: A stated coordination arrangement.

options.label: Legal instrument
options.definition: A legal or regulatory instrument relevant to the action.

options.label: Risk context
options.definition: Risk background or assessment information.

options.label: Vulnerability
options.definition: Susceptibility or vulnerability information.

options.label: Inclusion
options.definition: Participation, accessibility, equity or inclusion provisions.

options.label: Co benefit
options.definition: An additional positive effect claimed by the source.

options.label: Tradeoff
options.definition: A conflict, competing objective or adverse consequence identified by the source.

options.label: Dependency
options.definition: A stated prerequisite or dependency.

dimensions.label: Risk action links
dimensions.question: How is the action linked to risk?
dimensions.rule: A link must be explicit or justified through identified context, not guessed from a hazard word.

options.label: Assesses risk
options.definition: The action evaluates risk or its components.

options.label: Reduces exposure
options.definition: The action is stated to reduce exposure.

options.label: Reduces vulnerability
options.definition: The action is stated to reduce vulnerability.

options.label: Builds capacity
options.definition: The action is stated to strengthen relevant capacity.

options.label: Prepares
options.definition: The action supports readiness for an event.

options.label: Responds
options.definition: The action supports disaster response.

options.label: Supports recovery
options.definition: The action supports recovery.

options.label: Context only
options.definition: Risk is described as background without a supported action link.

options.label: Not stated
options.definition: The source does not state an action-risk relationship.

dimensions.label: Relation kinds
dimensions.question: How do statements relate across sources?
dimensions.rule: Relationships require paired evidence. Preserve disagreements and do not count translations as new commitments.

options.label: Same variant
options.definition: The statements express the same substantive target variant.

options.label: Translation equivalent
options.definition: The statements are verified equivalents across languages.

options.label: Revises
options.definition: A later statement modifies an earlier one.

options.label: Supersedes
options.definition: Evidence establishes that one statement replaces another.

options.label: Related
options.definition: The statements are substantively linked without a stronger verified relationship.

options.label: Contradicts
options.definition: The statements make incompatible assertions within a comparable scope.

options.label: Not restated
options.definition: A prior statement is not found again in the reviewed later scope; this is not proof of repeal.

options.label: Parent child
options.definition: A broader commitment contains a more specific action or target.

options.label: Unresolved
options.definition: The relationship cannot yet be resolved.

dimensions.label: Change kinds
dimensions.question: What changed across eligible editions?
dimensions.rule: Apply only to established earlier/later scope. Missing processing cannot establish a change.

options.label: Added
options.definition: A statement appears in the later reviewed edition and is not found in the earlier scope.

options.label: Restated
options.definition: The substantive statement is retained.

options.label: Number changed
options.definition: A numeric value changed; retain both bases and units.

options.label: Scope changed
options.definition: Geographic, sectoral or other scope changed.

options.label: Condition changed
options.definition: A condition or scenario changed.

options.label: Not restated
options.definition: The earlier statement is not restated in the later reviewed scope.

options.label: Withdrawn
options.definition: The source explicitly establishes withdrawal.

options.label: Unresolved
options.definition: The change cannot be characterized reliably.
